tracks.name: NCBI RefSeq - RefSeq All

ucsc.longLabel: NCBI RefSeq genes, curated and predicted (NM_*, XM_*, NR_*, XR_*, NP_*, YP_*)

differsFromUcsc.note: UCSC's table has no NCBI transcript attributes. Where a transcript's accession.version, span and exons match NCBI's GFF3 exactly, this track adds NCBI's feature type, tag (MANE Select, RefSeq Select), exception and transl_except. JBrowse picks a gene's representative isoform by that tag and translates selenocysteine through transl_except, so those transcripts can draw and translate differently than in the UCSC Genome Browser.

tracks.description: NCBI RefSeq genes, curated and predicted (NM_*, XM_*, NR_*, XR_*, NP_*, YP_*) (differs from UCSC: NCBI's tags and transl_except added where transcripts match NCBI's annotation)

tracks.name: N-SCAN

ucsc.informant: Marmoset N-SCAN used mouse (mm9) as the informant for conservation. PASA clustered human ESTs were mapped to the marmoset genome with the use of the human/marmoset synteny chain track. These remapped clusters were then filtered for splice sites, and used as the EST track on marmoset.
